summary:
A simple, prototype-level payment certificate and contract administration platform for a UAE contractor/consultant operation, working in AED. Country: United Arab Emirates (AE); currency: AED; build level: prototype.

Primary user: the QS (quantity surveyor) who runs contract administration end to end, plus a small team with role-based access (e.g. QS, contracts/commercial lead, finance reviewer, approver). Prototype scope — keep it deliberately simple, one clean path rather than configurability
